title: First and second conditional
en:
First conditional — a real possibility in the future: If + Present Simple, will + infinitive: If the supplier is late, we will lose a day.

Also with unless (= if not) and imperatives: We won't finish unless you help. If you see him, tell him to call me.

Second conditional — an imaginary or unlikely situation now/future: If + Past Simple, would + infinitive: If I had more time, I would study every day. If I were you, I'd take the job.

No will / would in the if-part. The if-part can go first (with a comma) or second.
ru: 1-й тип: реальное будущее — If + Present Simple, will + глагол (If it rains, we will stay). unless = если не. 2-й тип: воображаемое — If + Past Simple, would + глагол (If I had time, I would…; If I were you…). В части с if нет will / would.

boss.situation: Write about risks: 3 first-conditional sentences (“If the supplier is late, we will…”) and 2 second-conditional sentences (“If I were the director, I would…”).
samples: If the supplier is late, we will miss the deadline.
If we find a mistake, we will inform the manager.
We won't get the bonus unless we meet the targets.
If I were the director, I would hire more auditors.
If we had a better system, we would save a lot of time.

qs.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
If you send it today, they ___ get it on Monday.
What would you do if you ___ the lottery?
We won't finish on time ___ you help us.
If I ___ you, I'd apply for that job.
If the system ___ down again, call IT.
She ___ more if she had more time.
“If I will see her, I will tell her” is correct.
qs.exp: No will after if: If I see her, I'll tell her.

qs.q: “If I had a car, I would drive to work” is about an imaginary situation.
If you ___ (be) late again, you'll lose your bonus.
a: are

qs.q: If I ___ (have) more money, I would buy a flat in Almaty.
a: had

qs.q: If we find the error, we ___ (fix) it immediately.
a: 'll fix
will fix

qs.q: I ___ (not / do) that if I were you.
a: wouldn't do
would not do

qs.q: ___ you study, you won't pass the exam.
a: Unless

qs.q: If she ___ (know) the answer, she would tell us.
a: knew

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: if the supplier is late we will lose a day

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: if i were you i would talk to him

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: what will you do if they say no

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: we would save time if we had a better system

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: call me if you need help

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i will not sign it unless i read it

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “If I will have time, I will help you.”
a: If I have time, I'll help you.
If I have time, I will help you.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “If I would be rich, I would buy a house.”
a: If I were rich, I would buy a house.
If I were rich, I'd buy a house.
If I was rich, I would buy a house.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “If it rains, we stay at home tomorrow.”
a: If it rains, we'll stay at home tomorrow.
If it rains, we will stay at home tomorrow.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “If I had a car, I will drive to work.”
a: If I had a car, I would drive to work.
If I had a car, I'd drive to work.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Unless you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.”
a: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
If you do not hurry, you will miss the bus.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “What you would do if you lost your job?”
a: What would you do if you lost your job?

qs.q: Если поставщик опоздает, мы потеряем день.
a: If the supplier is late, we will lose a day.
If the supplier is late, we'll lose a day.

qs.q: Если бы у меня было больше времени, я бы занимался каждый день.
a: If I had more time, I would study every day.
If I had more time, I'd study every day.
If I had more time, I would practise every day.
If I had more time, I would practice every day.

qs.q: На твоём месте я бы согласился на эту работу.
a: If I were you, I'd take the job.
If I were you, I would take the job.
If I were you, I would take this job.
If I were you, I would accept the job.
If I were you, I would accept this job.

qs.q: Если найдёшь ошибку, скажи мне.
a: If you find a mistake, tell me.
If you find an error, tell me.
If you find a mistake, let me know.
If you find an error, let me know.

qs.q: Мы не закончим, если ты не поможешь.
a: We won't finish unless you help.
We will not finish unless you help.
We won't finish if you don't help.
We will not finish if you do not help.
We won't finish unless you help us.
We won't finish if you don't help us.

qs.q: Что бы ты сделал, если бы выиграл миллион?
a: What would you do if you won a million?
What would you do if you won one million?

qs.q: Если будет дождь, мы останемся дома.
a: If it rains, we'll stay at home.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If it rains, we'll stay home.

qs.q: Если бы я был директором, я бы нанял больше аудиторов.
a: If I were the director, I would hire more auditors.
If I were the director, I'd hire more auditors.
If I was the director, I would hire more auditors.
If I were a director, I would hire more auditors.
